units.source_text: 不知为什么，舞鹤湾这个名字像以往一样引起了我的心潮激荡。

en.t: For some reason, the name Maizuru Bay stirred my heart as intensely as ever.

units.source_text: 我的童年是在志乐村度过的，

en.t: I spent my childhood in Shiraku Village,

units.source_text: 从我童年时起，它就是看不见山海的总称，

en.t: and since my childhood, that name had meant all the mountains and seas I could not see,

units.source_text: 终于成了"海的预感"这个名字了。

en.t: until at last it became a name for the premonition of the sea.
